fields.title: Sierra Leone tender notice
fields.description: One record per tender row on NPPA's public Bids/Tenders board (or a single _error record when a keyword matches nothing, or the board can't be fetched). Raw passthrough from nppa.gov.sl/bid/'s TablePress table -- no registration/reference number is exposed upstream beyond whatever appears inside the free-text description.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The keyword that produced this record, or "(all bids)" when no keyword filter was given.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-bid-tenders-table, or 'none' on error).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_rowIndex.title: Row index
_rowIndex.description: 0-based position of this tender in NPPA's table (newest first, as published upstream).

_totalMatches.title: Total matches
_totalMatches.description: Total tenders matching this keyword (or total tenders on the board, for "(all bids)"), before any maxResults truncation.

_truncated.title: Truncated
_truncated.description: True if _totalMatches exceeded maxResults and not every match was pushed to the dataset.

biddingOrganization.title: Bidding organization
biddingOrganization.description: The procuring government entity, exactly as published (formatting/spacing quirks in the source are preserved verbatim).

datePosted.title: Date posted (raw)
datePosted.description: The Date Posted cell exactly as published (format is inconsistent upstream, e.g. "14-08-2026" vs "30- 04-2026").

datePostedIso.title: Date posted (parsed)
datePostedIso.description: Best-effort ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) parse of datePosted. Omitted when the raw value couldn't be parsed.

expirationDate.title: Expiration date (raw)
expirationDate.description: The Expiration Date cell exactly as published.

expirationDateIso.title: Expiration date (parsed)
expirationDateIso.description: Best-effort ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) parse of expirationDate. Omitted when the raw value couldn't be parsed.

isExpired.title: Expired
isExpired.description: True if expirationDateIso is before today (UTC). Omitted when expirationDate couldn't be parsed -- NPPA does not remove expired rows on its own.

descriptionOfBidding.title: Description of bidding
descriptionOfBidding.description: Free-text description of the tender, exactly as published.

documentUrl.title: Tender document URL
documentUrl.description: Direct link to the tender's PDF document. Omitted when the upstream row has a broken or missing download link (a real, occasional data-quality issue on NPPA's board, not a parsing failure).

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed/empty job (no_results, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.
